name: herdr-vscode-sync
description: Mirror Herdr workspaces into a single multi-root VS Code window.

commands.title: Herdr VS Code Sync: sync now

herdrVscodeSync.foldersFile.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `folders.json` file the Herdr plugin writes. When empty, the extension auto-discovers it under the Herdr config directory (`~/.config/herdr` on Linux/Mac, `%USERPROFILE%\.config\herdr` on Windows).
